name: Insulated boxes and coolers
summary: Insulated boxes and bags that keep things cold or hot for hours to days.
uses: Keeping food and medicine cool with ice
Body for a Peltier or ice-box fridge
identify: Camping and fishing coolers, polystyrene shipping boxes at pharmacies, labs, hospitals and fish markets, insulated delivery bags, and dead fridges and chest freezers (a dead chest freezer is a superb cooler). Remove or break the latch on any dead fridge so a child can’t get trapped.
test: Check the lid seals all round and the walls aren’t cracked. A good cooler holds ice for a day or more.

decay.note: Lasts. Lid seals harden over years.
